name: document purchase VAT evidence reviews
sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS document_purchase_vat_evidence_reviews (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  document_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES documents(id),
  document_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(document_sha256)=64),
  payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload_sha256)=64),
  company_context_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(company_context_sha256)=64),
  bank_transaction_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_transactions(id),
  bank_evidence_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(bank_evidence_sha256)=64),
  business_evidence_reference TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(business_evidence_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000),
  business_evidence_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(business_evidence_sha256)=64),
  rationale TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(rationale)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000),
  legal_basis TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(legal_basis='formal_invoice_deficiency_only'),
  supersedes_review_sha256 TEXT CHECK(supersedes_review_sha256 IS NULL OR length(supersedes_review_sha256)=64),
  review_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(review_sha256)=64),
  actor TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(actor)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
  principal TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(principal)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
  program TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(program)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS document_purchase_vat_evidence_reviews_document_id ON document_purchase_vat_evidence_reviews(document_id,id DESC);
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS document_purchase_vat_evidence_reviews_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON document_purchase_vat_evidence_reviews BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'purchase VAT evidence reviews are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS document_purchase_vat_evidence_reviews_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON document_purchase_vat_evidence_reviews BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'purchase VAT evidence reviews are append-only'); END;
